visualStyle.name: watercolor artwork
visualStyle.promptStyle: soft watercolor illustration, gentle pencil outlines, warm transparent washes, expressive child-friendly faces, airy backgrounds, reverent Primary teaching visuals, polished picture-book quality
constraints: No words, lettering, numbers, watermarks, or labels inside images.
Jesus Christ, when shown, should be reverent and visually consistent.

slides.imageDescription: Diverse Primary children helping one another on a warm path while Jesus Christ is represented reverently in soft light behind them.
slides.imagePrompt: Soft watercolor picture-book title image for Kind Like Christ. Show diverse Primary-age children helping one another on a warm golden path, with Jesus Christ represented reverently in soft light behind them. Joyful, kind, simple, child-friendly, open sky for title overlay. Gentle pencil outlines and transparent watercolor washes. No text inside image, no crosses.
